shifts.summary: Reasoning was generally easy, most candidates attempted most questions. Quantitative aptitude was the toughest section with many time‑consuming problems. General Awareness difficulty varied but overall was moderate. English showed mixed difficulty, ranging from easy to moderate. Transport problems were reported by a few candidates.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Most questions were doable; a few time‑intensive items were skipped. Sectional timer caused some unanswered items.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: Static GK and recent current‑affairs dominated. Some niche topics like BRICS and budget were also asked.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Advanced calculations and lengthy problems created heavy time pressure.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Active‑passive transformations were common; cloze and vocabulary items varied in number.

shifts.summary: Candidates found the shift overall easy to moderate. Reasoning was generally easy but some found it moderate due to timing pressure. Quantitative aptitude showed mixed difficulty with most reporting moderate. English was mostly easy with good attempts across the board.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: A few questions were left because of the sectional timer, most questions were doable, and a small number of new pattern items caused slight timing issues. Some items were time‑consuming but not hard.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: GA segment was completed quickly with 25 questions in 8 minutes, and the content was largely traditional GK and criminal law topics.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Two long Time‑Work questions ate time, arithmetic calculations were lengthy, and while some advanced parts were easy once formulas were known, overall timing was critical.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Grammar and comprehension were easy, though many words made full attempts harder; candidates made 5‑6 guesses and took a bit more time on the passage.

intro: The Tier 1 analysis for the SSC CGL exam held on 10 October 2026 includes reported data for Shifts 1 and 2, while Shift 3 is still pending. Reasoning was generally easy in Shift 1 and easy to moderate in Shift 2, with Quantitative Aptitude being the most challenging section in Shift 1. English difficulty ranged from easy to moderate across the shifts. The figures presented are unofficial and SSC normalises scores across shifts.
